AvailabilitySnapshot.description:
Whether something is there to be read or acted on, and the coded reason
when it is not.

The reason is a stable identifier, never the sentence an interface shows a
human: a client made to parse that sentence would break the day it is
reworded, and translating the interface would break every such client at
once.

aggression_provenance.description: Where the aggression these bubbles draw comes from.

enabled.description: Aggression bubbles are drawn over the chart.

floored_quantity.description:
The exact quantity the trader's own display floor keeps off the canvas.
Floored, not dropped: it is still in the totals.

lane_enabled.description: And over the live lane, which is a separate switch.

overlap_merge.description:
Bubbles are drawn as volume dots, Bookmap style: one dot per bar,
window of market time and price level of whole ticks, both sides in
it as a pie, sized by the volume its cell holds. Windows and levels
are anchored at exchange epoch 0 and price zero and picked by the
zoom, so a closed dot never changes. The bubble setting `overlap_merge`, switched by
`layers.visibility.set` as layer `bubble_overlap_merge`.

volume_dots.description:
The rungs and size scales the last volume-dots frame was built on;
absent when the pane last drew no dots.

VolumeDotsSnapshot.description: What a volume-dots frame was keyed and sized on.

candle_base_window_ms.description:
The newest bar's candle window in milliseconds, the base rung at this
zoom; absent when that bar is one window.

candle_px_per_bar.description:
Pixels a bar takes on the candles: each bar's window is the smallest
rung at least one dot wide inside its slot, from the bar's own
duration.

candle_size_reference_per_second.description: The quantity of a full-size candle dot for each second of its window.

level_ticks.description: Native ticks per price level, on both panes.

tape_size_reference.description: The quantity of a full-size tape dot.
